newsitem.title: USA: WinStar says signs interconnect pacts.
newsitem.headline: WinStar says signs interconnect pacts.

text.p: WinStar Communications Inc said Thursday it has signed agreements with two companies outlining the interconnection of their networks in the District of Columbia, Maryland, Michigan, New Jersey and Virginia.
The agreement covering Michigan was signed with Ameritech Corp. The pact covering the other territories was signed with Bell Atlantic Corp.

WinStar said it now has similar agreements covering 18 of the 41 major market areas in which it plans to offer its competitive local exchange carrier business over the next three years. It is negotiating additional pacts, it said.
